acceptance: Stream query SQL places the label and the query on separate lines (real newline), or the label moves outside the SQL text
A test executes or parses a generated TPC-DS stream query and proves the query body is not commented out
The comment-policy fixture for the stream label in quality/comment-policy.json matches the new emitted text or is removed
context: Discovered on branch feat/comment-cleanup-program (comment cleanup effort, 2026-10-03). Do not change benchmark algorithms beyond the label/newline fix without review.
description: benchbox/core/tpcds/streams.py (TPCDSStreamManager._generate_single_stream) builds stream SQL as f"-- Query {query_id}{variant}\\n{base_query}" and the failure path as f"-- Query ... (generation failed: {e})\\nSELECT 1 AS placeholder_query;". The source uses a literal backslash-n ("\\n"), not a newline, so the label and the whole query form one SQL comment line. Any consumer that executes stream_query.sql would run nothing. The pattern is on develop (present at ad79a381d and origin/develop), so it predates the comment cleanup. Found during the comment cleanup; the label is kept and registered as an emitted-output fixture there, so changing it needs that fixture updated too.
